0022600107.text: The Hawks (2-0, first in the Southeast and first in the East) host the Rockets (2-0, first in the Southwest and third in the West) in Atlanta's third game of the season. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Houston is missing Fred VanVleet (knee) and Steven Adams (ankle), and Reed Sheppard is day-to-day with a knee bruise and is a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Hawks lost 0-2 to Houston, most recently 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026.
